title: Admission Process
marquee: Enquire via WhatsApp — quick counselling with our admissions team
Montessori · Child Psychology · Special Education · Language & more

steps.title: Choose Your Course
steps.text: Browse our programmes and select the course that matches your goals.

steps.title: Check Eligibility
steps.text: Review eligibility criteria on the course page or speak with our team.

steps.title: Send Enquiry on WhatsApp
steps.text: Fill the form and tap Enquire via WhatsApp — your details are sent directly to our admissions team.

steps.title: Speak with Admissions
steps.text: Our counsellor will guide you on mode, schedule and fee details.

steps.title: Complete Formalities
steps.text: Submit documents and complete payment as advised.

steps.title: Begin Training
steps.text: Start your learning journey with SPEDICS!

courseFee: Most courses: Certified ₹10,000 (3 months), Diploma ₹15,000 (6 months). Montessori also offers PG Diploma ₹35,000 (12 months). Spoken English/Hindi ₹3,000 (3 months, 3 classes/week). Phonics ₹5,000 (2 months, 2 classes/week). Tamil/Telugu ₹3,000 (3 months).
documentsRequired: ID proof, educational certificates, passport-size photograph (details provided on application)
